project_type: Greenfield Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod (modid forzacraft, package vn.forzacraft) + art pipeline (Blockbench scripts, Aseprite Lua). Repo /projects/sandbox/Forzacraft, branch main, no worktree.
language: Java 17 (mod), JavaScript (Blockbench scripts via tools/bb/bbexec.mjs), Lua (Aseprite), Python 3.11 stdlib (tools/gen), bash (tools/ci)
build_system: ForgeGradle from the Forge 1.20.1-47.4.28 MDK (https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/1.20.1-47.4.28/forge-1.20.1-47.4.28-mdk.zip), Gradle wrapper from the MDK, official mappings, Mixin. Quirk: ALWAYS run `. /projects/sandbox/.tools/env.sh && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH` first: env.sh sets JAVA_HOME to JDK 17.0.2 but plain `java` on PATH is the mise JDK 25 shim; system gradle 8.14.6 must not be used, use ./gradlew. Use --no-daemon (or start daemons via proc_start). First build decompiles Minecraft (~10-15 min).
test_framework: JUnit 5 (`./gradlew test`) for pure-Java code (physics, camera math, geo loader, heightfield, road planner); Forge GameTests in vn.forzacraft.gametest (`./gradlew runGameTestServer`, namespace forzacraft, templates under data/forzacraft/structures/gametest/ generated by tools/gen/make_platform_nbt.py); server-side commands `fc selftest`, `fc map stats`, `fc map preview` driven by tools/ci/server-smoke.sh.
test_command: bash tools/ci/done-check.sh  (build + runGameTestServer + server-smoke); compat: COMPAT=server bash tools/ci/server-smoke.sh (adds Distant Horizons via -PcompatServer)
verification_instructions: DONE CHECK per phase: 1) ./gradlew build passes on JDK 17; 2) ./gradlew runGameTestServer exits 0; 3) tools/ci/server-smoke.sh boots a headless dedicated server (eula in run/, nogui, FIFO stdin), runs `fc selftest` (must print FORZACRAFT SELFTEST OK), stops, no ERROR/Exception in run/logs/latest.log; 4) every new asset has a Blockbench screenshot in art/screenshots/ that you viewed (node tools/bb/bbexec.mjs --screenshot <png>, then view the image); 5) phase features demonstrated by GameTests/JUnit/server commands, evidence written into the FEAT findings. Client visual check under Xvfb is optional (last phase).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Committed generated files: GameTest .nbt templates (python3 tools/gen/make_platform_nbt.py), geo.json + .bbmodel exported by art/blockbench/**/*.js scripts, PNG textures + .aseprite sources exported by art/aseprite/**/*.lua, small screenshots in art/screenshots/. Never commit build/, run/, .gradle/, world data, the Aseprite binary or /projects/sandbox/.tools.
environment_constraints: Root fs and /root read-only; /tmp private per shell command (use /projects/sandbox/.tools/home or repo build dirs for scratch). Long-running processes (Xvfb, Blockbench, MC server if it must outlive a command, Gradle daemons) only via workspace MCP proc_start/proc_status/proc_stop with names xvfb (bash tools/setup/run-xvfb.sh) and blockbench (bash tools/setup/run-blockbench.sh, ready_regex 'DevTools listening'); reuse running ones; never nohup/&. Sandbox stops ~60 min after the user's browser disconnects: commit + push often. 8 cores, 30 GB RAM, ~86 GB disk. Network reachable: Forge maven, Modrinth API/maven (DH 3.3.3-1.20.1, Embeddium 0.3.31+mc1.20.1, Oculus 1.20.1-1.8.0).
contribution_requirements: Work directly on main; `git add <specific files> && git commit -m '<conventional commit>' && git push origin main` after EVERY completed plan item; never force-push. Read .agents/inbox.md (append-only user answers) at the start of every turn. Never pause for the user: register uncertain items in .agents/questions.md, notify with send_message severity 'info', mark the item DEFERRED (Qn), continue. Never answer a question for the user. Open: Q1 library mods (GeckoLib) -> use the built-in geo renderer, GeckoLib switch deferred; Q2 distribution format -> pack export and pregen artifacts deferred; Q3 map radius 12000 vs 24000 -> default 12000 in map JSON. All UI text Vietnamese (vi_vn.json copied to en_us.json). All car/place names fictional, no real brands. Explosions never destroy blocks (Level.ExplosionInteraction.NONE). Only third-party mods allowed: Oculus, Embeddium, Distant Horizons; stay compatible. Note: .agents/ is matched by a global gitignore; files under .agents must be staged with `git add -f <path>`.
key_patterns: Decisions are in plan.md 'Architecture decisions' and (after item 1.2) docs/decisions.md + docs/scale.md: 1 block = 1 m for player/cars, environment x2 (lane 7 blocks) with walkable-size door/stairs exceptions and stylised terrain heights; pure-Java physics in vn.forzacraft.physics; driver-client-authoritative cars, server bots/collisions; self-contained geo.json loader; data-driven JSON under data/forzacraft/forzacraft_vehicles, forzacraft_races, forzacraft_maps; each map is its own dimension using chunk generator codec forzacraft:map and dimension type forzacraft:map_tall (min_y -64, height 704); camera via Camera#setup mixin, vanilla perspective key cycles mod modes only while driving. Blockbench: 16 px = 1 block, scripts build models via the JS API and return {__files:{path:text}}; see tools/bb/examples/smoke-test.js. Aseprite: see tools/aseprite/README.md.
directory_structure: Today: README.md, tools/{bb,aseprite,setup}, .kiro/steering, .agents/{inbox.md,questions.md,tasks/forzacraft}. Planned: src/main/java/vn/forzacraft/{physics,vehicle,network,client/{camera,model,render,hud,screen,input},economy,race,ai,mode,world/{map,gen,road,scenery,procedural},block,command,gametest,mixin}, src/main/resources/{assets,data}/forzacraft, src/test/java, art/{blockbench,aseprite,screenshots}, docs/, tools/{ci,gen}.
